0022600199.text: Dallas hosts Brooklyn in the Mavericks' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Mavericks (5-4) sitting 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, while the Nets (2-7) are 13th in the East after a loss. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Mavericks won their 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
